description: Repairs a pseudo-ArenaScript while keeping its own conditions: mechanical fixes (header, sections written inline, ATR syntax), removal of the sections the engine refuses, then line-by-line removal of what the preflight of the Lab's Rust engine refuses (each removal is listed). valid comes from the engine alone. If no executable entry condition is left, the tool says so (ok=false) instead of inventing a strategy.
name: repair_arenascript
